id: This Pokémon seems like its in trouble. Take it along for now.
en: This Pokémon seems like its in trouble. Take it along for now.
it: Questo Pokémon sembra in difficoltà. Per ora portalo con te.

id: Virbank City\nCity of falling fog and rising stars!
en: Virbank City\nCity of falling fog and rising stars!
it: Virbopoli\nCittà di nebbia che scende e stelle che sorgono!

id: \rWould you look at the size of that boat? I wish I owned it.
en: \rWould you look at the size of that boat? I wish I owned it.
it: \rHai visto quanto è grande quella nave? Vorrei che fosse mia.

id: \bWelcome to Virbank City. This place is home to a lot of performers. Roxie is in a band too.
en: \bWelcome to Virbank City. This place is home to a lot of performers. Roxie is in a band too.
it: \bBenvenuto a Virbopoli. Qui vivono molti artisti. Anche Velia suona in una band.

id: \bThere's been a strange looking Pokémon seen in town. What's going on?
en: \bThere's been a strange looking Pokémon seen in town. What's going on?
it: \bIn città è stato avvistato un Pokémon dall'aspetto strano. Che sta succedendo?

id: \bI've given up trying to beat Roxie. She is too hard for me.
en: \bI've given up trying to beat Roxie. She is too hard for me.
it: \bHo smesso di provare a battere Velia. È troppo forte per me.

id: \rCynthia: Hello again \PN. Having fun in Unova? A friend of yours is staying with me and they thought you might want to visit.
en: \rCynthia: Hello again \PN. Having fun in Unova? A friend of yours is staying with me and they thought you might want to visit.
it: \rCamilla: Ciao di nuovo, \PN. Ti diverti a Unima? Un tuo amico è ospite da me e ha pensato che ti farebbe piacere venire a trovarci.

id: \rI'm staying at Undella Town. You can get there by going east through Nimbasa City.
en: \rI'm staying at Undella Town. You can get there by going east through Nimbasa City.
it: \rAlloggio a Spiraria. Puoi arrivarci andando a est passando per Sciroccopoli.

id: \rThere is also going to be a competition. The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. I'm sure you would be a great participant.
en: \rThere is also going to be a competition. The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. I'm sure you would be a great participant.
it: \rCi sarà anche una competizione: la Coppa Junior del Pokémon World Tournament. Sono sicura che saresti un ottimo partecipante.

id: \rI'll be waiting for you. Don't take too long.
en: \rI'll be waiting for you. Don't take too long.

id: \rCynthia: I'll be waiting for you at Undella Town. Don't take too long.
en: \rCynthia: I'll be waiting for you at Undella Town. Don't take too long.
it: \rCamilla: Ti aspetto a Spiraria. Non metterci troppo.

id: \rI wonder what else is out there. I've never left the city before.
en: \rI wonder what else is out there. I've never left the city before.
it: \rChissà cos'altro c'è là fuori. Non ho mai lasciato la città.

id: Poison days, poison on the stage!
en: Poison days, poison on the stage!
it: Giorni di veleno, veleno sul palco!
\bMi dispiace tanto per il mio Aipom.

id: \bI take to the seas every day. I can't stay away from it.
en: \bI take to the seas every day. I can't stay away from it.
it: \bPrendo il mare ogni giorno. Non riesco a starne lontano.
